findings.summary: programStateRepo.observe(program.id) returns Flow<ProgramState?> (a non-null Flow reference), but the code never calls .first() on it despite importing kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first and the accompanying comment claiming 'resolving via .first()'. initialState is therefore always a non-null Flow object, so initialState == null is always false and startDestination is always TopLevelRoute.Main -- onboarding will never be shown, even for a brand-new install with no ProgramState. This inverts the entire purpose of the task: it doesn't read a single value from the repository at all, it just captures the cold Flow handle.

Had any test actually exercised the onboarding-vs-main branch, it would have caught the Critical always-Main bug above.
